investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC: curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser/JS execution) against the venue's homepage, its full /agenda listing page (a plain Drupal View, still an unauthenticated static fetch, paginated ?page=0..8), the /acces-et-infos-pratiques page (address confirmation), and one individual /evenement/{slug}?s={id} detail page (bounded, single sample, to check for a richer per-event JSON-LD block).

probe_history.reason: A plain curl GET of the homepage found a Drupal 11 site (confirmed by the page's own '<meta name="Generator" content="Drupal 11">') whose homepage itself carries no current event listing, only navigation links to /agenda. A further plain GET of /agenda (still unauthenticated, no JS) returned static HTML with a rich, self-contained card per event: title (h2), source-provided category (field_event_type: 'Concert'/'Émission en public'/'Événement'/etc.), a full day/month/year date stated three separate ways on the SAME card (an outer wrapper's own data-date="YYYY-MM-DD" attribute, plus separate Event-Day/Event-Month/Event-Year divs), a weekday+time text, a combined venue+room location string, and a stable-looking '?s={numeric-id}' query parameter on every event's own /evenement/{slug} permalink. This alone fully answers the investigation question with no escalation needed. A bounded, single-sample per-event detail page was additionally fetched (not required to answer Level 1, but to check for further structured data) and found a genuine data-quality caveat — see field_assessment.time.

venue_reference: Maison de la Radio et de la Musique (Radio France's multi-hall concert/broadcast complex, 116 avenue du Président Kennedy, 75016 Paris)

identity.notes: The retained homepage's own <title> reads 'Accueil | Maison de la radio et de la Musique' at the venue's own domain maisondelaradioetdelamusique.fr, and the retained /acces-et-infos-pratiques page directly states 'Kennedy' and postcode '75016' — a first-party match to this investigation's assigned venue address (116 avenue du Président Kennedy, 75016 Paris).

site_classification.platform: Drupal 11 (confirmed by the page's own Generator meta tag). The /agenda listing is a plain, static, paginated Drupal View (?page=0..8, ~14 cards/page, ~126 events total observed via pagination links) with no JSON-LD on the list page itself; individual /evenement/{slug}?s={id} detail pages DO carry their own JSON-LD (both a generic 'Event' block and a separate 'MusicEvent' block), but — see field_assessment.time — the MusicEvent block's own machine-readable startDate was found to CONFLICT with the same event's own list-card time text, so the list page's own static cards are the recommended acquisition path, not the per-event JSON-LD.

title.notes: Each /agenda card's own <h2 class="Bolder-XXL"> title text, stated directly.

start_date.notes: Stated directly and redundantly on the SAME card two ways: the card's own outer wrapper 'data-date="2026-09-02"' attribute, and separate 'Event-Day'/'Event-Month'/'Event-Year' divs ('02'/'septembre'/'2026'). Both agree on every sampled card.

time.notes: Each card's own weekday+time text (e.g. 'Mercredi' / '20h30'), stated directly. IMPORTANT DATA-QUALITY CAVEAT found via the one bounded per-event detail-page sample: that same event's own separate JSON-LD 'MusicEvent' block states a CONFLICTING 'startDate': '2026-09-02T14:00:00+02:00' (14:00, not 20:30) — while a second, different JSON-LD 'Event'-typed block on the SAME page states 'mer 02/09/2026- 20:30' (a text field, matching the list card). This is recorded honestly as a genuine site-side inconsistency between two of the source's own structured-data blocks, not resolved by guessing which is 'right' — the list card's own weekday+time text is used as this field's PROVEN value because it is corroborated by a second first-party block on the same page, while the MusicEvent JSON-LD's ISO startDate is the outlier. A collector MUST prefer the /agenda list card's own text (or the corroborating 'Event' JSON-LD's text startDate), never the 'MusicEvent' block's ISO startDate, for this source.

end.notes: No end time or end date appears anywhere on the /agenda card, nor in either of the two JSON-LD blocks on the sampled detail page.

venue_location.value: Maison de la Radio et de la Musique - Studio 105 (room varies per event, e.g. 'Bal Chavaux' for the sampled Fontaines DC concert)
venue_location.notes: Each card's own 'Small location' div states the venue name plus its own specific named hall/studio directly (e.g. 'Maison de la Radio et de la Musique - Studio 105', or 'Bal Chavaux' alone for another sampled card) — this multi-hall complex names a different internal room per event, all stated directly on the card, never inferred.

source_record_id.notes: Every event's own '<a href="/evenement/{slug}?s={numeric-id}">' permalink carries a distinct numeric 's=' query parameter (observed consistently across all sampled pages/cards, e.g. 1513800, 1474830, 1382599, ...) — this is the site's own canonical URL identity for the event (Drupal's own internal entity/session reference embedded directly in its own permalink scheme), used here as source_record_id per the same 'site's own permalink is its own canonical path' judgement already established for tempodrom-berlin-01/les-trois-baudets-paris-01.

event_url.notes: Absolute URL built from each card's own href, resolved against the site's own origin.

price.notes: Some cards' own 'more-info' block states the literal word 'Gratuit' (free) directly — a genuinely PROVEN fact for those specific events — but most sampled cards show no price text at all (that same block instead shows a performer/ensemble name, or nothing). The one sampled detail page's own 'TARIFS' aside block stated a real price range directly, confirming per-event pricing exists via the detail page, but this was not exercised at scale within this investigation's bounded scope. Recorded PARTIAL, not PROVEN or NOT_PRESENT, to honestly reflect this heterogeneity.

blockers.description: A per-event JSON-LD 'MusicEvent' block's own 'startDate' was found to disagree with that SAME event's own /agenda list-card time text (14:00 vs 20:30) on the one sampled detail page. A collector for this source MUST use the /agenda list card's own day/month/year + weekday/time fields (this investigation's recommended, single, self-consistent data path) and must NOT consume the per-event 'MusicEvent' JSON-LD block, which this investigation found to be unreliable for time-of-day on at least one real record.

This is a large, multi-purpose complex whose /agenda listing mixes music concerts with non-music content (radio-show recordings ('Émission en public'), masterclasses, generic 'Événement' entries). A collector should filter on the card's own source-provided 'field_event_type' category (observed values include 'Concert', 'Émission en public', 'Événement') to select genuinely music-relevant listings, e.g. category === 'Concert' — a source-provided classification, not a keyword guess.

reasons: Identity PROVEN from a self-consistent retained artifact (homepage title/domain, /acces-et-infos-pratiques' own stated Kennedy/75016 address).
acquisition_class STATIC_HTML, a resolved supported class, reached at Level 1 with no escalation needed.
A CONFIRMED public data path retained: the /agenda list page, richly structured, self-contained per card.
title, start_date, time, venue_location, source_record_id, and event_url are ALL PROVEN with basis DIRECT_SOURCE.

A genuine, honestly-documented data-quality finding (a per-event JSON-LD MusicEvent block's own startDate disagreeing with the corroborated list-card time) is recorded as a MAJOR blocker with a clear, actionable mitigation (use the list card, not that JSON-LD block) — not silently resolved by guessing which source is right.
recommended_family STATIC_EVENT_LIST, an existing named family in this project's collector-family vocabulary.
